what: aide-memory-web is a nested git repo inside aide-v0. Changes to aide-memory-web files (theme.config.jsx, components, styles, pages) don't stage with the parent repo's git add — they need to be committed and pushed from within the aide-memory-web directory separately.
why: Discovered when git add aide-memory-web/theme.config.jsx silently did nothing — the file is tracked by the nested repo's .git, not the parent.
